[[Alchemical Conservation]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Alchemical Conservation]]:''' This item modifies the user's energy expenditure in such a way that many abilities can be used more frequently than normal. You will gain +1 [[ki]] on every successful attack, and you will increase the number of [[Action Boost]]s, [[Turn Undead]] attempts, and [[Bard song|Bard Song]]s you can use per rest by 1 each.
These additional uses will only take effect after you rest.
